The league began in April 12 and ended in December 13. For this year, the league was contested by 17 teams. [[Kashima Antlers]] won the first stage and [[Júbilo Iwata]] won the second stage. Júbilo Iwata won the J.League title after winning both matches in the [[J.League Championship|Suntory Championship]]. ==Clubs== {{commons|1997 J.
